# ConfirmDialog

Asks the user to confirm an action, with Cancel focused first. It is always a centered dialog, on phones too, and an outside press does not dismiss it. The actions stack full width on phones, the confirm action at the bottom, nearest the thumb.

```tsx
import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/registry/ouro/components/ouro/dialog/confirm-dialog";
```

## Example

```tsx
<ConfirmDialog
  title="Delete recipe?"
  description="This can't be undone."
  confirmLabel="Delete"
  tone="destructive"
  onConfirm={() => deleteRecipe(id)}
  trigger={<Button tone="destructive" variant="soft">Delete</Button>}
/>
```

## Usage

Use `tone="destructive"` for destructive actions, and return a promise from `onConfirm` to show progress until the action finishes.

It stacks above the page at `--ouro-layer`, a z-index of 50 by default (from ouro-base.css). Raise `--ouro-layer` if your app has fixed bars above z-50: `:root { --ouro-layer: 60; }`.

Testing accessibility: in WebKit, Base UI's focus guards take `role="button"` without a name so VoiceOver's cursor stays trapped. Exclude them: `new AxeBuilder({ page }).exclude("[data-base-ui-focus-guard]")`.

## Use instead when

- Use `Dialog` instead when the user has more to do than confirm or cancel.

## Props

Props every mode takes. Type: `ConfirmDialogProps`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cancelLabel` | `string` | `"Cancel"` | The cancel button's label. Cancel has focus when the dialog opens. |
| `confirmLabel` (required) | `string` |  | The confirm button's label: the action, not "OK" (`confirmLabel="Delete"`). |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  | What happens if the user confirms: `description="This can't be undone."`. |
| `finalFocus` | `RefObject<HTMLElement \| null>` |  | Where focus goes when the confirmation closes. By default it returns to the trigger; when `onConfirm` removes the trigger, point this at what replaces it (give a heading `tabIndex={-1}`): `finalFocus={headingRef}`. |
| `onConfirm` (required) | `() => void \| Promise<void>` |  | Runs the action. Return a promise to keep the dialog open while it runs: the confirm button shows `loading` until it settles. When it resolves the dialog closes; when it rejects (or `onConfirm` throws) the dialog stays open so the user can retry or cancel. Cancel and Escape still close it while pending; the result is then ignored. If the action removes the trigger (a delete), pass `finalFocus` to what replaces it, such as the next item or the page heading. |
| `title` (required) | `string` |  | The question, which names the dialog: `title="Delete recipe?"`. |
| `tone` | `"primary" \| "destructive"` | `"primary"` | The confirm button's color role. Use `destructive` for destructive actions. |

## Modes

`ConfirmDialogProps` is a union: pass the props of exactly one mode. Mixing them is a type error.

### Controlled: `ConfirmDialogControlledProps`

A controlled ConfirmDialog: you own `open` and update it in `onOpenChange`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onOpenChange` (required) | `(open: boolean) => void` |  | Called with `false` when the user cancels (Cancel or Escape) and when `onConfirm` finishes. |
| `open` (required) | `boolean` |  | Whether the confirmation is open. |

Not in this mode (typed `never`):

- `trigger`: Not with `open`. Remove `open` and `onOpenChange` to let a trigger open the confirmation.

### With trigger: `ConfirmDialogWithTriggerProps`

An uncontrolled ConfirmDialog: `trigger` opens it.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` (required) | `ReactElement` |  | The element that opens the confirmation, usually a Button: `trigger={<Button tone="destructive">Delete</Button>}`. |

Not in this mode (typed `never`):

- `onOpenChange`: Not with `trigger`. Remove `trigger` to control the confirmation with `open` and `onOpenChange`.
- `open`: Not with `trigger`. Remove `trigger` to control the confirmation with `open` and `onOpenChange`.

## Don't use

These are not props. Passing one fails the type check with the fix in the error, and in development a console message names the fix.

- `cancelText`: Not a prop. Ouro UI uses `cancelLabel`: `<ConfirmDialog cancelLabel="Keep">`.
- `confirmText`: Not a prop. Ouro UI uses `confirmLabel`: `<ConfirmDialog confirmLabel="Delete">`.
- `destructive`: Not a prop. Ouro UI uses `tone`: `<ConfirmDialog tone="destructive">`.
- `isOpen`: Not a prop. Ouro UI uses `open` with `onOpenChange`: `<ConfirmDialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>`.
- `onCancel`: Not a prop. Cancel calls `onOpenChange(false)`: `<ConfirmDialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>`.
- `onClose`: Not a prop. `onOpenChange(false)` fires on close: `<ConfirmDialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>`.
- `variant`: Not a prop. Ouro UI uses `tone`: `<ConfirmDialog tone="destructive">`.
